name: Loprazolam
summary: Loprazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine sleep medicine, mainly used for short-term treatment of severe insomnia and sleep problems.
description: Loprazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine sleep medicine. It also calms anxiety, relaxes muscles and helps prevent seizures. It is mainly used for short-term treatment of severe insomnia and sleep problems. Because it doesn't stay in your body very long, it can suit people who have trouble falling asleep, without much next-day drowsiness when used as directed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Loprazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine hypnotic with anxiolytic, sedative, muscle relaxant, and anticonvulsant properties. It is primarily indicated for the short-term management of severe insomnia and sleep disturbances. Its relatively short half-life makes it suitable for patients who have difficulty falling asleep without significant next-day sedation when used appropriately.
